messages.author: 1bf3bb84a245eefc
messages.subject: RApache header question, please help
parts:
Hi All,

I need to add the following in my PHP code to make AJAX work across
cross domains:

header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *'); or
header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin: URL');

How do I do the same in R or brew so that JQuery-Ajax makes successful
calls to R scripts.
Currently all my ajax calls to R scripts across domains are failing.

Thanks,

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: RApache header question, please help
parts:
Use the setHeader function: http://www.rapache.net/manual.html#setHeader

Jeff

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: RApache header question, please help
parts:
RapacheLover... be sure to read the documentation thoroughly and then
study your code. But I do understand that having someone look it over
helps, too.

Your code's deficiency is merely syntactical. Here's the corrected code:

setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin","*")

Jeff
